line:menu_translation/fuckrace:interface.$RACE_CamTooltip_GP:
Hold [RB] for Camera Controls:
  [L-Stick] - Pan (Move)
  [R-Stick] - Orbit & Zoom
  [LT] / [RT] - Adjust FOV

Hold [RB] + [LB] for Lens Controls:
  [R-Stick] - Roll & Pitch

Other Shortcuts:
  [RB] + [Y] / [X] - Rotate Character
  [RB] + [L3] - Hide UI
  [RB] + [R3] - Screenshot
  [Hold Back] - Light Settings
line:menu_translation/fuckrace:interface.$RACE_CamTooltip_KBM:
Keyboard Controls:
  [CTRL] + [WASD]/[QE]/[RF] - Pan, Orbit & Pitch
  [CTRL] + [SHIFT] + [WASD]/[QE] - Zoom, FOV & Roll

Mouse Controls:
  [MMB] + [Drag] - Pan Camera
  [MMB] + [RMB] + [Drag] - Orbit Camera
  [MMB] + [CTRL] + [Drag] - Pitch Camera
  [MMB] + [CTRL] + [SHIFT] + [Drag] - Roll Camera
  [CTRL] + [Scroll] - Zoom Camera
  [CTRL] + [SHIFT] + [Scroll] - Adjust FOV
  [RMB] + [Drag] - Rotate Character

Other Shortcuts:
  [SHIFT] + [F11] - Hide UI
